original_text:
Write cleaner PySpark code - no more temp views!

If you’re like me and use spark.sql() a lot in PySpark, chances are your code is full of .createOrReplaceTempView() lines. It works, sure ,but it can get messy real quick.

Well, there’s a better way now! Since Spark 3.4.0, you can directly pass DataFrames to SQL without creating temp views.

That means:
✔️ Less boilerplate
✔️ No view name conflicts
✔️ Code’s way easier to reuse and read

Honestly, this made my pipelines feel much more readable.

♻ Feel free to re-share this post if you find it helpful.

Follow Abhay Singh
